title: Interaction of bioactive kaempferol with HMGB1: Investigation by multi-spectroscopic and molecular simulation methods.
authors: Shen, Pingping; Sun, Yueming; Jiang, Xuewa; Zhou, Xiaoyang; Nian, Binbin; Wang, Weiwei; Zhang, Jian
journal: Spectrochimica acta. Part A, Molecular and biomolecular spectroscopy
one_liner_zh: 该文研究山奈酚与HMGB1蛋白的相互作用，采用光谱实验和分子模拟，但对象为蛋白-小分子而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽含模拟但非TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联较弱。
abstract: Chronic and persistent inflammation associated with excessive high mobility group protein 1 (HMGB1) is a risk factor for various diseases. Dietary intake of kaempferol has been proven to be effective in reducing HMGB1 levels and the degree of inflammation, but the structural mechanism remains unclear. In this context, we first investigated the interaction between bioactive kaempferol and HMGB1 using multi-spectroscopic and molecular simulation techniques. The surface plasmon resonance (SPR) data indicated that kaempferol binds directly to HMGB1 with a K(d) value of 2.89 x 10(-5) M. Binding of kaempferol with HMGB1 led to the intrinsic fluorescence quenching and modest secondary structure change of HMGB1 supported by fluorescence spectrometry and circular dichroism (CD). Using dynamic light scattering (DLS), it was found that kaempferol induced the aggregation of HMGB1 protein complex to form larger particles. On HMGB1-activated RAW264.7 cells, kaempferol co-incubation exhibited a remarkable inhibitory effect on nitric oxide (NO) release with an IC(50) value of 5.02 muM, which was lower than that of quercetin. In silico, kaempferol binds to HMGB1 mainly through hydrogen bonds and hydrophobic forces. Collectively, our study showed kaempferol as a potential HMGB1 inhibitor, mainly acting by direct binding to HMGB1 and inducing its conformational changes, which provides clues for the treatment of chronic inflammation by kaempferol.
abstract_zh: 与过量高迁移率族蛋白1（HMGB1）相关的慢性持续性炎症是多种疾病的危险因素。膳食摄入山柰酚已被证明能有效降低HMGB1水平和炎症程度，但其结构机制尚不清楚。在此背景下，我们首先利用多光谱和分子模拟技术研究了生物活性山柰酚与HMGB1之间的相互作用。表面等离子体共振（SPR）数据显示，山柰酚直接与HMGB1结合，其K(d)值为2.89 x 10(-5) M。荧光光谱和圆二色光谱（CD）分析表明，山柰酚与HMGB1的结合导致HMGB1固有荧光猝灭及二级结构适度改变。通过动态光散射（DLS）发现，山柰酚诱导HMGB1蛋白复合物聚集形成更大颗粒。在HMGB1激活的RAW264.7细胞上，山柰酚共孵育对一氧化氮（NO）释放表现出显著抑制作用，其IC(50)值为5.02 μM，低于槲皮素的相应值。在计算机模拟中，山柰酚主要通过氢键和疏水作用与HMGB1结合。总体而言，我们的研究表明山柰酚是一种潜在的HMGB1抑制剂，主要通过直接结合HMGB1并诱导其构象变化发挥作用，这为山柰酚治疗慢性炎症提供了线索。
